mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iot_product(tenant_id, product_key, name, description, protocol_type, device_type, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{productKey}, #{name}, #{description}, #{protocolType}, #{deviceType}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, product_key, name, description, protocol_type, device_type, status, created_at, updated_at FROM iot_product ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE iot_product SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, protocol_type = #{protocolType}, device_type = #{deviceType}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE product_key = #{productKey}
UPDATE iot_product SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE product_key = #{productKey}
